basic_details.job_title: JNPA Safety Inspector (Asstt. Manager) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) has advertised 1 unreserved post of Safety Inspector (Asstt. Manager (Safety)) on the pay scale 40000 – 140000 (Pre-revised Scale 16400-40500). Applications must be sent by post, speed post, registered post or courier to General Manager (A) & Secy., Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai, and must reach on or before 23 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only by post, speed post, registered post or courier, on working days and during working hours only. No email or online submission route is given for sending the application. Address: General Manager (A) & Secy., Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, NAVI MUMBAI – 400707. Envelope: write clearly "Application for the post of Safety Inspector (Asst. Manager (Safety))". Form: details of the applicant are to be given in the prescribed proforma printed in the notice, headed "Application for the post of ... in JNPA". It asks for full name in block letters, address, phone and email, present employer and post, date of birth, age as on 1 November 2026, category, PWD status, educational qualifications, employment details, whether the applicant meets the post requirements, and documents attached. It ends with a declaration and signature. Attachments: self-attested photocopies in proof of age, qualifications, experience, training, caste, PWD certificate and Ex-Servicemen discharge book (as applicable), and a passport size photograph. JNPA takes no responsibility to consider any certificate sent separately, and does not assume responsibility if an application does not reach the address by the last date for any reason.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One post is advertised: Safety Inspector (Asstt. Manager (Safety)), 1 (One), Unreserved, on the pay scale 40000 – 140000 (Pre-revised Scale 16400-40500). The notice does not name allowances or other pay components. Essential (i): Degree in Physics or Chemistry from recognised university, OR Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics Engineering from a recognized Institute. Essential (ii): Diploma in Industrial safety from recognized Institute. Essential (iii): 05 years' experience in a Port or an Industrial Unit dealing with safety in handling explosive material and hazardous goods. Desirable: Working Knowledge of Hindi and Marathi. Qualifications must be from a recognized Indian University approved by the UGC, a recognized Indian Institute approved by AICTE, or a recognized State/Central board of Higher Secondary education. The candidate must hold a valid mark-sheet and degree or diploma certificate of the prescribed qualification as on 01.11.2026. Candidates without certificates of the essential qualifications are not eligible. The notice gives these as the basic criteria; please check the official notification for the full eligibility rules. Minimum age 18 years and maximum age 35 years, to be reckoned as on 01/11/2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit: Employees of the Board of any Major Port Trust who hold the prescribed qualification and experience may also apply, provided the age limit in such cases does not exceed 55 years. Ex-servicemen (ex-employees of India's Defence Forces with not less than 6 months' continuous service) get relaxation up to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces, where the vacancy is unreserved. The same applies to dependents of those killed in action, up to the extent of the service rendered. The post is not earmarked for PWBD candidates. Candidates seeking relaxation must submit copies of the certificates and produce the originals at verification. A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka or the East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia and Vietnam intending to settle permanently in India. Candidates in the Nepal, Bhutan, Tibetan refugee and migrated Indian origin categories must hold a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies are attached to the application and the originals are produced at verification. Non-submission of requisite documents debars the candidature. Proof of Date of Birth: Birth Certificate issued by the Competent Municipal Authorities, or SSLC / Std. X Certificate with DOB. Mark-sheets and certificates of educational qualifications and other eligibility documents. Experience certificates on the letter head of the company or firm, with dates of joining and relieving and date-wise details of posts held. For the present organization, the appointment order and a document certifying present employment (certificate from the organization, last salary slip etc.). Caste certificate with caste validity certificate from the competent authority, for SC / ST / OBC candidates. For the unreserved post, SC/ST/OBC candidates are considered General Category. OBC certificate must contain the non-creamy layer clause and be valid on the date of verification, issued within one year before it. OBC candidates in the creamy layer, or whose caste is not in the Central List, should indicate their category as General. Disability certificate in the prescribed format from a Medical Board (Annexure-I), and from the District Medical Board for Persons with Disability (OH) category (Annexure-III). No Objection Certificate from the employer for candidates serving in Government, quasi Government offices or Public Sector Undertakings (including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions). Certificate of eligibility from the Government of India for nationality categories (b), (c), (d) and (e), and any other relevant documents in support of eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a competitive written examination and/or personal interview, followed by verification of original documents. The weightage of marks is 90% for the competitive written examination and 10% for the interview. JNPA reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the written examination or interview, based on preliminary screening or short-listing by qualifications, age and relevant experience. The notice does not give the examination date, pattern or syllabus. Elsewhere it says shortlisting for further selection will be on the basis of performance in an Online Test "as applicable", and that JNPA may hold any other test it considers necessary. Shortlisted candidates must show the required documents in original. Non-submission, or documents that do not meet the prescribed criteria, ends the candidature. Admission to later stages is provisional until documents are verified.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JNPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for Safety Inspector (Asstt. Manager (Safety)). It is unreserved.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNPA Safety Inspector post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach JNPA on or before 23 December 2026, on working days and during working hours.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for JNPA Safety Inspector (Asstt. Manager (Safety))?
faq.answer: A Degree in Physics or Chemistry from a recognised university, or a Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics Engineering from a recognized Institute, is required. A Diploma in Industrial safety and 5 years' experience in a Port or Industrial Unit dealing with safety in handling explosive material and hazardous goods are also essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 35 years, as on 01/11/2026. SC/ST get 5 years, OBC (Non-creamy layer) 3 years and Person With Disability 10 years of relaxation in the upper age limit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the JNPA Safety Inspector post?
faq.answer: The pay scale is 40000 – 140000 (Pre-revised Scale 16400-40500).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed proforma with self-attested photocopies and a passport size photograph by post, speed post, registered post or courier to General Manager (A) & Secy., Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, NAVI MUMBAI – 400707. Write "Application for the post of Safety Inspector (Asst. Manager (Safety))" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a competitive written examination and/or personal interview, with weightage of 90% for the written examination and 10% for the interview. Documents are verified in original for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can employees of a Major Port Trust apply?
faq.answer: Yes, employees of the Board of any Major Port Trust with the prescribed qualification and experience may apply, provided the age does not exceed 55 years.

faq.question: Q9. Is a No Objection Certificate needed?
faq.answer: Yes, for candidates serving in Government, quasi Government offices or Public Sector Undertakings, including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions. It is produced at document verification, otherwise the candidature will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Is the post reserved for PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: No, the notice says the post is not earmarked for PWBD candidates. The single post is unreserved.
